description: This file defines the interface and class structure for managing a list of station entries (`dm_sta_list_t`) in a wireless mesh network context. It includes class declarations, method signatures for initialization, configuration, database synchronization, and station list management, but no implementation details.

classes.name: dm_sta_list_t
classes.description: An interface class for managing a list of station objects, with methods for initialization, configuration, database operations, and station access.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the station list management system or component.

methods.name: get_dm_orch_type
methods.description: Retrieves the DM orchestration type for a specified station by querying the database.

methods.name: update_list
methods.description: Updates the list with station data based on operation type.

methods.name: analyze_config
methods.description: Analyzes a JSON configuration array and generates commands accordingly.

methods.name: init_table
methods.description: Initializes internal data structures or tables.

methods.name: init_columns
methods.description: Sets up columns or fields needed for data management.

methods.name: sync_db
methods.description: Synchronizes the state with the database using provided client and context.

methods.name: update_db
methods.description: Performs database update operations based on specified operation type.

methods.name: search_db
methods.description: Searches the database for a specific entry using a key.

methods.name: compare_db
methods.description: Compares a database client with a station object.

methods.name: update_row
methods.description: Updates a row in the database; signature indicates variable arguments.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sets configuration data into the database for the client or station.

methods.name: get_config
methods.description: Retrieves configuration data from JSON or station list.

methods.name: get_first_sta
methods.description: Returns the first station object in the list (pure virtual).

methods.name: get_next_sta
methods.description: Returns the next station object following a given station (pure virtual).

methods.name: get_sta
methods.description: Fetches a station object based on a key (pure virtual).

methods.name: remove_sta
methods.description: Removes a station from the list by key (pure virtual).

methods.name: put_sta
methods.description: Adds or updates a station in the list with a given key (pure virtual).
